C1.worst_defect: The first screen says what it is and gives two clear buttons, but nothing above the fold says who should not use it. The deal-breakers a buyer comparing it with Square or Shopify POS needs (no integrated card terminal, no cash drawer, Postgres only, web till only) first appear in 'Before you start', about two screens down.
C1.where: home.desktop.01 hero vs home.desktop.02 'Before you start'

C2.worst_defect: The site asks you to run your tills on the hosted app at app.vendurepos.com, but gives that app no version, release date or changelog anywhere. The Changelog covers only '@vendurepos/plugin', last released 2026-10-06, six weeks before capture. A buyer can't tell what the hosted till is running, when it changes ('expect changes before 1.0'), or whether the project is still active. The live demo already refunds at the till and takes a customer note, which no released plugin supports, with no version or date for either.
C2.where: changelog.desktop.01; home.desktop.02 table row 'Refund a sale at the till'; text/at-the-till.txt 'Order details'

C3.worst_defect: The path is complete and ordered, and 'Check it worked' is good. But the role the plugin's own 'New POS till key' creates is missing ReadOrder in both 0.2.0 and 0.3.0, so every reader has to apply the same manual workaround ('Also add ReadOrder, or the till sells but its order history is refused'), repeated in quick-start step 4, Connect a till (twice) and the Changelog. Nor is there a step that confirms the plugin is live (for example GET /tally/v1/info) before step 8's sign-in.
C3.where: quick-start.desktop.02 step 4; text/connect-a-till.txt 'Create and use a device key'

C4.worst_defect: The docs contradict each other on version requirements. Quick start's Troubleshoot says the store 'must advertise order.create v4 and register v1', but Notifications says the same update notice holds back 'fee and shipping charges', which need v5 (plugin 0.3.0). The Changelog's 0.2.0 bullet says a key with the vendurepos-pos-till role 'does everything a till does', then in the same bullet says that role cannot read orders.
C4.where: quick-start.desktop.04 '9. Troubleshoot'; text/notifications.txt; changelog.desktop.01 last 0.2.0 bullet

C5.worst_defect: Limitations is one flat list of 17 bullets with no grouping or severity. The data-loss warning ('Sales not yet sent are kept only in this browser ... those sales are lost') gets the same weight as 'Device keys need plugin 0.2.0 or later'. The At the till payment screenshot also shows a test-fixture product, 'Tally Fixture Mug', which looks toy-grade.

C6.worst_defect: The phone layout holds up: the comparison table turns into stacked cards and code wraps. The defect is in the phone hero screenshot of the till, which shows a truncated 'Q...' column header in the cart, so the first product image on a phone looks cramped.

C7.worst_defect: Every sitemap lastmod is a timestamp from 2026-11-17 or 2026-11-18 (for example the Changelog at 2026-11-18T18:14:23, though its newest entry is 2026-10-06), so lastmod tracks builds, not content changes. The SoftwareApplication JSON-LD has no softwareVersion.

overall_worst.defect: The site asks you to run your tills on the hosted app at app.vendurepos.com, but never says which app version is live, when it last changed, or who maintains it. The only changelog is for the plugin, last released 2026-10-06, and the demo already does things (refund at the till, customer note) that no released plugin supports. A sceptic can't tell whether the project is active or what a client's tills will be running next week.
overall_worst.where: changelog.desktop.01; home.desktop.02 'Live demo or your own store'; home footer
overall_worst.fix: Show the hosted app's version and last-deploy date (in the home badge next to 'plugin 0.3.0' and in the docs), and add an app section to the Changelog that lists the demo-only features with the plugin version they will need.
